mlm:name: LRS-VQA
description: A text-guided token pruning method for efficient vision-language understanding of large remote sensing images, introducing a Region Focus Module (RFM) and Dynamic Image Pyramid (DIP), and a new benchmark LRS-VQA with 7,333 QA pairs across 8 categories and image lengths up to 27,328 pixels.
pretext_training_type: Text-guided token pruning with attention distillation
masking_strategy: Text-guided token pruning via Region Focus Module (RFM)
pretraining: Pre-trained on 558K data from LLaVA-1.5; SFT with 484K samples including LLaVA-1.5-665K, RSVQA-HR, and template-based samples from FAIR1M-1.0, GLH-Bridge, and STAR datasets.
domain_knowledge: Dynamic image pyramid for multi-scale inference
backbone_modifications: Dynamic Image Pyramid (DIP) for multi-scale inference

additional_pretraining_stages.mlm:pretrained_source: 484K SFT samples (300K from LLaVA-1.5-665K, 146K from RSVQA-HR, 38K template-based from FAIR1M-1.0, GLH-Bridge, STAR)
